name: Europäischer Fernwanderweg E11, Brandenburg (W)
description_md:
The Europaeischer Fernwanderweg E11 in Brandenburg is a waymarked hiking route in Germany. It measures 124.3 km and is signposted as E11.

This hard route requires about 36 hours of walking time on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. It features 1621 m of ascent and 1720 m of descent within an international waymarked hiking network. The route passes Glienicke Bridge within 400 m, Potsdam within 800 m, and Brandenburger Tor within 1300 m.
